description: This PHP source file defines the 'LdapConfigurationController' class, which manages the LDAP configuration view in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller, uses traits for configuration services, and prepares a Vue component with LDAP sync settings for rendering.

classes.name: LdapConfigurationController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling LDAP configuration settings within the OrangeHRM admin plugin. It prepares a Vue component with LDAP sync status for rendering.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the LDAP configuration Vue component with relevant LDAP settings, such as whether to show sync options based on the LDAP setting configuration.
